power.answer: Gulf Air allows each passenger a maximum of two lithium-ion power banks, each up to 100 Wh, with protected terminals. They may not be recharged from the in-flight supply, may not power other devices, and may not be stored in overhead lockers.

sections.h: 🔋 What Gulf Air says about power banks
sections.p: From the Gulf Air Conditions of Carriage, article 8.3.8 "Power banks", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Gulf Air rule
rows: A maximum of two lithium-ion power banks per passenger
Protected against damage and short circuits
Not allowed from the in-flight power supply
A power bank must not be used to charge or supply other devices; you may use the in-flight charging points to power your own devices directly
Not in overhead lockers; keep it readily accessible, for example in the seat pocket or on your person
Make sure your devices are charged; Gulf Air does not provide charging to replace this

list: Not on the page: this article does not say whether power banks may go in checked baggage; ask Gulf Air.

faq: How many power banks can I take on Gulf Air?
A maximum of two lithium-ion power banks per passenger, each up to 100 Wh.
Where must I keep my power bank on Gulf Air?
In the seat pocket or on your person, not in the overhead locker, so it can be reached quickly in an emergency.
Can I charge my phone from a power bank on Gulf Air?
No. A power bank must not be used to charge other devices during the flight; use the in-flight charging points for your devices instead.
